decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical shared DOS assembler macro library.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The file defines assembler macros including I_NEED, INVOKE, I_AM, procedure and conditional transfer helpers; it is included directly or through DOS symbol includes in selected BIOS and DOS modules.
Previously compared DIR2 and FAT modules match all 1413 and 984 target MSDOS.SYS bytes respectively (reviews 054 and 065).
The previous MSLOAD comparison found only the shared version byte differing across 1446 bytes (review 019).
limitations: Module comparisons support macro expansions exercised in the selected builds, not every macro or option. Final linking and complete core file identity remain unverified.
